paragraphs.text: The House of Bolk is one of the five Houses in Estark , located in Kush , on Dominaria .

Bolk's color is brown, and its fighters are generally associated with black and green mana. It flies a brown-and-gold-striped pennant. Before the Time of Troubles , the building of Bolk looked like a fortress, with crenellated towers and battlements. As of the 998th Festival in 4069 AR , the House hosted 87 fighters, who wore brown doeskin tunics, trousers, and leather capes, and over 50 warriors.
Kirlen (from before the Night of Fire until the Time of Troubles )
Erwina : a fighter paired against Haglin of Fentesk in the arena.
Farnin : he fought against Petrakov of Fentesk to avenge his lover's death, but he too was killed by Petrakov.
Gilrash : he was beaten by Norreen in a match of oquorak (a martial art), despite his breaking of the rules.
Ogla : a fighter paired against Alinar of Fentesk in the arena.
